name: Velocity
description: Breakneck pace and intricate rhythms. Where beats collide and patterns emerge from chaos. The realm of pure kinetic energy.

name: Flow
description: Hypnotic grooves and rhythmic motion. The sweet spot between melody and beat. Designed to move you.

name: Serenity
description: Ethereal soundscapes and meditative atmospheres. Space to breathe. Time to reflect.

name: Expression
description: Human voices and raw emotion. Stories told through sound. The triumph and struggle of being alive.

name: Foundation
description: The bedrock of modern music. Raw power and timeless structure. Built to last.

name: Dialogue
description: Conversation between instruments. Complex conversations in real time. Improvisation as art form.

name: Horizon
description: Australian artists bridging realms. Fresh perspectives from the land down under. The new frontier of sound.
